corrections.note: CAUSE REMOVED, not worked around. On 2026-09-29 the operator removed the host-level PreToolUse `Bash` hook (~/.claude/hooks/skim-rewrite.sh -> `skim rewrite --hook`) from ~/.claude/settings.json, and this change removes scripts/setup-host.sh section 7, which installed skim and ran `skim init` on every host bootstrap. Dispatched agents symlink that same settings.json, so no agent on this host is rewritten any more; the same `cat` that came back annotation-stripped before the removal returned the file verbatim afterwards. Decision basis (a four-seat study on 2026-09-28, worst cases reproduced against skim 2.3.1): 26/584 sampled agent Bash calls were rewritten and the net token effect was slightly NEGATIVE (`skim git diff` renders whole files, 12,052 -> 63,898 chars), while bare or piped `cargo test`/`cargo nextest run` became a no-op exiting 0, `grep -rn X dir` returned rc 2 with empty output, `ls -la` returned empty output, `git status --porcelain` became prose, `git log -p` fabricated its commit count and pseudo-mode `cat` stripped `self` and type annotations. The task-5955 guard (scripts/skim_hook_guard.py) prevented only the whitespace flattening this entry records and was deleted uninstalled in the same change; task 5683's COMPOUND_COMMAND_REWRITE_GUIDANCE is retired under its own retirement clause (no host running the factory wires the hook). A recurrence of this symptom after 2026-09-29 means the hook has been reinstalled (a manual `skim init` re-adds it); check ~/.claude/settings.json before reopening.
